name: Regulatory & Agency Alert Monitor

parameters.content:
## Regulatory & Agency Alert Monitor

### Internal Protomated tool — Authority pillar, not deployed to clients

Relevant agency and bar updates are scattered across dozens of sources and easy to miss. This watches a configurable list of public agency/bar RSS feeds and produces a weekly digest, tagged by which of the firm's (or a given vertical's) practice areas each item likely affects — feeding Protomated's own newsletter/Field Notes content pipeline and informing BD conversations.

### How it works

1. Runs weekly. Pulls from a configurable list of public agency and bar association RSS feeds.
2. Tags each recent item against a configurable practice-area keyword map — an item can affect more than one practice area, or none (dropped if none match).
3. Drafts a plain-English digest grouped by practice area, with a templated 'why this matters' blurb per matched keyword — not real legal analysis.
4. Logs the draft to a review ledger and emails it to the content reviewer. Nothing publishes without a human pass.
5. Separately, a stale-draft reminder nudges the reviewer if a draft sits unreviewed too long.

**This monitors and summarizes public information only — it is explicitly informational, never advice.** It never touches legal work, gives compliance guidance tailored to a specific firm's situation, or drafts anything that could be read as legal or professional advice (ABA Op. 512 doesn't directly apply since this isn't law-firm-facing, but the same discipline is kept).

**This never publishes anything on its own.** It only ever produces a draft digest and routes it to a human reviewer.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with a 'Regulatory Digest Drafts' tab — see the deploy guide for exact columns.
- [ ] Configure Google Sheets OAuth2 and SMTP credentials.
- [ ] Set the required n8n Variables: AGENCY_BAR_FEED_URLS, PRACTICE_AREA_KEYWORDS, CONTENT_REVIEWER_EMAIL, FIRM_FROM_EMAIL, REGULATORY_LOG_SHEET_ID.
- [ ] Optionally tune DIGEST_LOOKBACK_DAYS and STALE_DRAFT_REMINDER_DAYS.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization

AGENCY_BAR_FEED_URLS and PRACTICE_AREA_KEYWORDS are the entire content-sourcing and tagging surface — swap in real feed URLs (state bar publications, agency press releases, DOL/EEOC-style regulator feeds, if they publish RSS) and edit the practice-area keyword map rather than editing the code.

## Pull, tag, and draft the weekly digest

Reads a configurable list of public feeds, keeps recent items, tags each one against the firm's practice areas, and drafts a plain-English digest grouped by which areas are affected.

## Stale draft reminder — a second, independent branch

Checks the digest drafts log for anything still sitting at pending_review past a configurable age, and nudges the reviewer.

nodes.name: If Feed URLs Configured
nodes.notes: Checked here, while there's still guaranteed exactly one item from the trigger -- an unconfigured AGENCY_BAR_FEED_URLS routes to a setup-needed notice instead of the run silently dying at zero items.

nodes.name: Build Feed URL List
nodes.notes: AGENCY_BAR_FEED_URLS is the entire source list — a comma-separated list of RSS feed URLs (state bar publications, agency press releases, regulator feeds).

nodes.name: Draft Setup-Needed Notice
nodes.notes: Fires only when AGENCY_BAR_FEED_URLS is empty — keeps the log and review email showing up on schedule even before feeds are configured.

nodes.name: Fetch Each Agency Bar Feed
nodes.notes: Runs once per feed URL from the list above, fetching that feed's current items.

nodes.name: Tag Items By Practice Area Impact
nodes.notes: PRACTICE_AREA_KEYWORDS and DIGEST_LOOKBACK_DAYS control what makes it into the digest and how it's tagged. An item with zero practice-area matches is dropped.

nodes.name: Draft Regulatory Digest
nodes.notes: Groups the tagged items by practice area — the same item can appear under multiple areas if it matched keywords in more than one.

const d = $json;
return { json: { ...d, digest_id: 'REGDIGEST-' + Date.now(), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } };

nodes.name: Assign Digest ID
nodes.notes: This ID ties the sheet row to this run.

nodes.name: Log Digest Draft For Review
nodes.notes: Every weekly run gets a row here, even a 'nothing matched this week' one. Column headers must match exactly.

nodes.name: Build Digest Review Request Email
nodes.notes: Falls back the recipient to FIRM_FROM_EMAIL if CONTENT_REVIEWER_EMAIL isn't set, so a missing variable can't crash the send.

nodes.name: Send Digest Review Request Email
nodes.notes: This is an internal Protomated notification, not a client communication — no compliance guardrail wrap needed.

nodes.name: Check For Stale Regulatory Drafts Weekly
nodes.notes: Runs weekly, Thursday 9am by default — a few days after the Monday digest.

nodes.name: Read Regulatory Digest Drafts Log
nodes.notes: Reads the full log — filtered down to stale pending drafts in the next step.

nodes.name: Find Stale Pending Regulatory Drafts
nodes.notes: STALE_DRAFT_REMINDER_DAYS controls the age threshold — defaults to 5 days.

nodes.name: If Any Stale Regulatory Drafts Found
nodes.notes: Only sends a reminder when there's actually something stale.

nodes.name: Build Stale Regulatory Draft Reminder Email
nodes.notes: Runs once for the whole batch of stale drafts, not once per draft.

nodes.name: Send Stale Regulatory Draft Reminder Email
nodes.notes: This is an internal Protomated notification — no compliance guardrail wrap needed.

nodes.name: Skip — No Stale Regulatory Drafts
nodes.notes: Nothing to nudge about this run — every draft has either been reviewed or is still fresh.
